Title: Observable<T>.scan accumulator seems to be called twice
Description: I am currently debugging why the scan {} accumulator lambda is getting invoked twice, even when only one event is getting emitted. It will however produce the correct result, because t will take correct previous count probably, resulting in the same updated count. I am developing an Android app but I don't know if that matters. Here's the logs:

```
2024-07-14 18:04:47.640  8672-8672  xyz                     app.example                          D  onEvent
2024-07-14 18:04:47.640  8672-8672  xyz                     app.example                          D  new event: Increment
2024-07-14 18:04:47.640  8672-8672  xyz                     app.example                          D  new event: Increment
2024-07-14 18:04:47.649  8672-8672  xyz                     app.example                          D  got state: CounterState(count=1, message=Counter is greater than 0)
```

And the relevant parts of my codebase:

```kotlin
abstract class Presenter<S : State<out Event>> {

  protected val subscriptions = CompositeDisposable()

  protected val eventSink = PublishSubject.create<CounterEvent>()

  abstract val mStateObservable: Observable<S>

  fun onEvent(event: CounterEvent) {
    Log.d("xyz", "onEvent")
    eventSink.onNext(event)
  }
}

class CounterPresenter : Presenter<CounterState>() {

  private val count = eventSink.scan(0L) { count, event ->
    Log.d("xyz", "new event: $event")
    when (event) {
      CounterEvent.Increment -> count + 1
      CounterEvent.Decrement -> count - 1
    }
  }

  // ...

  override val mStateObservable = Observable
    .combineLatest(count, message) { count, message -> 
        CounterState(count, message) 
    }
}
```
